# Fountain Life (AI-powered longevity & diagnostics clinic network)

URL: https://www.fountainlife.com/ — "Longevity Clinic of the Year 2025"

## Type system
- Display/body: `"Dm Sans Variable", Arial, sans-serif` throughout — H1
  60px/400, H2 48px/400, body 16px/400. A single geometric-humanist sans
  carries every level; italic is used within headlines for emphasis
  ("Live longer, *live healthier*").
- No serif, no mono.

## Color system
- bg: black `#000000` and near-black `#020202`/`#1B1B1B`/`#1E1E1E` —
  the darkest, most "tech" base in the dataset.
- text: white `#FFFFFF`.
- accent: electric cyan `#00DCF5` / lighter cyan `#71CFF1`–`#73CDF0`, plus a
  royal blue `#4169E1`/`#176BB5` — a glowing cyan-to-blue family used for
  card overlays, icons, and the "Zori AI" product mark specifically.
- Card surfaces use very subtle dark-grey elevation (`#333333`) rather than
  pure black, keeping the page from feeling flat.

## Layout & grid
- Full-bleed dark hero with italic headline and a translucent glass-morphism
  info card floating over hero photography (top-right).
- "How it works" section uses three square photographic tiles depicting
  scanning/testing equipment in extreme macro/close-up (skin, device,
  gloved hand) with dark overlays — reads closer to a biotech/pharma
  product shoot than lifestyle photography.
- "Meet our Members" uses a horizontal-scroll carousel of member portrait
  cards with pull-quotes.
- The "Detect. Prevent. Reverse." feature section stacks four full-width
  glowing-cyan panel cards (Neuroinflammation testing, Restorative
  Therapeutics, Always-on Care, Zori AI Medical Expert), each with a
  distinct cyan/teal gradient treatment and abstract data-visualization-like
  graphics rather than literal charts.

## Sections (order observed)
1. Full-bleed dark hero, italic headline, glass-card location/pricing
   teaser
2. "How it works" — 3 macro/close-up photographic step tiles
3. "Meet our Members" — horizontal member-testimonial carousel with a
   "Winner 2025 Global Tech Awards" badge
4. "Detect. Prevent. Reverse." — four glowing cyan feature panels
   (Neuroinflammation testing, Restorative Therapeutics, Always-on Care
   access, Zori AI Medical Expert)
5. "Member outcomes" — stat callouts (e.g., % improvement figures) on dark
   background
6. "Our memberships" — three dark plan cards (CORE / APEX / FAMILY) with
   glowing edge treatments
7. "Visit our locations" — city card carousel (Dallas, Orlando, Miami…)
8. FAQ accordion
9. Closing CTA + dark footer with large radial glow graphic

## Components/signature
- Glowing cyan gradient "glass" cards are the strongest signature device —
  every feature panel (diagnostics, therapeutics, AI concierge) is wrapped
  in the same glowing-edge treatment, unifying disparate services under one
  visual language that reads distinctly sci-fi/near-future.
- "Zori AI Medical Expert" is branded and visualized as its own product
  (app icon, glowing panel) rather than described only in text — AI is
  foregrounded as a named, visible feature.
- Macro/extreme-close-up photography of skin, devices, and gloved hands
  (rather than smiling lifestyle photography) reinforces a clinical,
  almost forensic mood even while the palette stays warm-toned in the hero.

## Motion/interactions
- Horizontal-scroll carousels for both member testimonials and location
  cards; glass-morphism cards likely have hover/parallax glow shifts given
  the gradient treatment.

## Biomarker/trust presentation
- No literal numeric biomarker table on the homepage — instead, abstract
  glowing data-visualization-style graphics stand in for "AI-Guided
  Diagnostics," implying data depth without showing raw numbers.
- Trust: a named "2025 Global Tech Awards" badge, member testimonial
  portraits with direct quotes, and outcome percentage stats in the
  "Member outcomes" section — leans on award/press credibility and
  aggregate stats rather than displaying individual clinician bios on the
  homepage.

## What works
- The near-black base with a single glowing cyan family is the clearest
  "near-futurist" execution in the dataset — successfully differentiates a
  clinic network from both the clinical-luxury (light, restrained) and
  scientific-dashboard (light, chart-heavy) poles of the category.
- Branding the AI concierge ("Zori") as a visible product with its own
  icon/panel is a reusable trust device: it makes "AI-powered" concrete
  rather than a vague marketing claim.

## Avoid
- All-caps reliance on glow/gradient effects across every panel can start
  to feel uniform/sample if not varied — vary panel composition (image vs.
  icon vs. abstract graphic) as this site does.
- Dark backgrounds with glowing cyan risk eye strain over a long page;
  this site mitigates it with generous black negative space between
  glowing elements — don't pack glow panels edge-to-edge.

## How to apply
- Use a near-black base with one glowing cyan/electric-blue accent family
  (not pure neon, keep some desaturation) applied consistently across
  every feature card to signal "AI-powered medical technology."
- Give a named AI feature its own visual identity (icon, colour, panel
  treatment) rather than describing "AI-powered" only in copy.
